Priya (CSM): Hey @Elaine — quick check: we have 12 seats allocated for the NovaCorp pilot, need to reconfirm final roster + SSO invites before Monday. Jordan, can you queue the SSO invite batch tonight? I'll share the feedback survey we'll send after week 1: https://redwood.ai/surveys/pilot-novacorp
Jordan (Ops): queued 12 invites, batch# 20260323-7. Will trigger SSO invites tonight. Left placeholders for 2 missing emails.
Elaine - NovaCorp: Thanks! We have 11 confirmed now — adding one more by EOD. Can one seat be a read-only observer for our legal reviewer?
Priya (CSM): Yes. @Ava can you set an observer role and add instructions to the onboarding doc? Also proposing a 15-min enablement call next Tue.
Ava (Onboarding): On it — observer role uses 'viewer' in RBAC. I added a section 'observer seats' to the onboarding doc: https://confluence.redwood/novacorp-onboard. Scheduled 2026-03-28 10:00 PT for a 15-min enablement; invite sent.
Sam (Product): Heads up: feature X is gated behind flag `fx-alpha`. If the pilot toggles it we'll need telemetry on. @Jordan can you enable telemetry for org 5772?
Jordan (Ops): Telemetry enabled for org 5772. Confirmed. Also flagged token spike pattern in session logs — tagging Optimize team.
Priya (CSM): Small renewal risk note — Elaine mentioned a budget review in April. Let's capture week1 feedback + an exec summary for their review. @Elaine can we aim for a 10-min summary call on 2026-04-04?
Elaine - NovaCorp: 4/4 works. Also can we get a per-seat usage export (CSV) for the review?
Priya (CSM): Yes. @Jordan please generate the usage export and scrub PII before we send.
Jordan (Ops): Generating export for org 5772 now. PII scrub will remove email hashes and IPs. ETA 2026-04-02, will share by 04-03.
Ava (Onboarding): I'll draft a 'what to look for' one-pager for the exec summary. Putting a draft in the doc — please comment.
Priya (CSM): I'll run two short feedback survey variants after enablement (A: 2 q's + optional comment; B: 3 q's). We'll A/B and prefer the shorter if response rate is low.
survey-bot: Survey 'pilot-novacorp-week1' created. Link: https://redwood.ai/surveys/pilot-novacorp/week1
Elaine - NovaCorp: One more ask — can one of your engineers join our kickoff to help with SSO edge-cases?
Sam (Product): I can join the first 20 mins. @Ashwin can help with infra edge-cases; looping him in.
Ashwin (Infra): Happy to join. For Okta SSO there may be a cert rotation step — please share SSO metadata ahead of time.
Priya (CSM): Thanks everyone. Summary of action items: Jordan — invites + usage export; Ava — observer role + one-pager; Sam & Ashwin — engineer coverage for kickoff; Priya — surveys + exec invite. I'll follow up with a short thread summary and attachments.
Elaine - NovaCorp: :thumbsup:
Jordan (Ops): :white_check_mark:
